title: What I Think and So
label: ch:ta-what-i-think-and-so
canDo: I can give an opinion with … eṉṟu niṉaikkiṟēṉ, … eṉṟu tōṉṟukiṟatu and eṉ karuttil, and give a result with ataṉāl, ataṉāltāṉ and eṉavē.

payoff.summary: Complete the last lesson of chapter 286: give an opinion and say what followed, with tōṉṟukiṟatu, eṉ karuttil, ataṉāl and eṉavē.
